title: Asahina Mafuyu — In The Warmth Of Glowing Dusk〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: In The Warmth Of Glowing Dusk（4★）
meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They're supposed to be for the night show, but how or when do you actually use them...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, they're supposed to light up!
But I don't know for sure since I thought it'd be fun to find out during the actual show.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but if you get one of the lucky bracelets, it's supposed to light up like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Light up like crazy? What do you mean? Don't the regular ones light up just fine?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure it's supposed to be almost blindingly bright and look like a rainbow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And apparently there are supposed to be other effects in store for everyone besides these bracelets.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, you don't look so good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is it because of your curfew?
Maybe if you leave now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay...
I'll stay to watch until the end.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(It happened again...
It's that same feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Kanade's hand... It feels a bit cold...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But warm at the same time... Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(And it isn't just her.
Ena, Mizuki, everyone... Whatever they're giving me feels... Nice...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That same part of me...feels warm again...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It's okay. I'm sure we can still get a bracelet from one of the mascots, so let's try looking for them. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But the show's about to start! Why do you have to be such a big slowpoke, Daddy?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, did they come too late for the bracelets?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like it...
I guess I'll have to just give her...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh? I can have your bracelet...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, you can have mine.
My friends and I can use the ones we got, so you and your dad can use this one.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I don't know what to say...
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not really. That was just to calm her down.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow...! Look at that! The Ferris wheel's all lit up!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Len and the others seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, Otori mentioned how this is a place that makes everyone smile...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is it! Get your bracelets ready!

rows.Speaker: Girl's Voice
rows.Line:
Wow! Look, Daddy! Look!
Mine's so bright!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, it's the girl from just earlier...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Mafuyu, that bracelet you gave her...! Doesn't this mean it's one of the lucky ones?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Then I was right to give it to her...
I'd rather not stand out by having anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure? I kinda wanted you to have some fun too, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too... Mafuyu, why don't I lend you mine? It might help you enjoy the moment a little...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, wanna use mine too?
Then you can double the fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, look!
That junior of yours is about to do something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's amazing! She's making the sky sparkle...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I think those lights are all drones!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I understand a little better what Otori meant by this place making everyone smile.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why is it that the voices of everyone around me sound so different...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I was just a bit startled.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, we might get a better angle if we go over there! Wouldn't it be better to have the Ferris wheel in full view behind us? I bet we can grab some amazing pics!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go! We can take a picture to commemorate our trip!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You too, Mafuyu.
If you keep spacing out like that, you're gonna get lost again.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Ena's hand feels the same as Kanade's... A bit cold... But warm at the same time...)
